title: STU-Net: Scalable and Transferable Medical Image Segmentation Models Empowered by Large-Scale Supervised Pre-training
mechanism: nnU-Net blocks modified so depth and width scale together (14M to 1.4B parameters), with supervised pretraining on TotalSegmentator for transfer.
adaptation: The pretrained weights are 3D CT and do not transfer to 2D EL. The only usable idea is joint depth+width scaling of a 2D nnU-Net, which the ResEnc L/XL arms already cover.
min_experiment: Only if ResEnc L beats M: run a 2D STU-Net-B/L-shaped net on the same folds; CV-mean crack relF1@2. Kill: no gain over ResEnc L.
evidence: R: larger models gain more after TotalSegmentator pretraining; in nnU-Net Revisited (from scratch) STU-Net S/B/L did not beat ResEnc L.
